tldr: Midday batch (Sep 8): Anthropic walked away from its ~$6B Decart acquisition after due diligence — the Nvidia-backed startup would have been its largest deal at a ~50% premium, though the pair may still partner and Decart's IPO marketing could start mid-October. OpenBMB's MiniCPM5-2B is confirmed as the best open-weights model under 4B params (53.9 avg across 34 benchmarks, 131K context, agentic tool use) — runs on llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio and MLX. Hermes Agent's Teknium clarified subagent constraints: no inter-subagent chat, fresh context per subagent, final work only to the orchestrator.

articles.title: Hermes Agent: subagents can't talk to each other — Teknium clarifies
articles.summary: Teknium: Hermes subagents get fresh orchestrator-provided context and submit only final work — no inter-subagent chat. Key for multi-agent designs.
